Based on my search, here's what you need to know about watching MSNBC (now rebranded as **MS NOW**) live streaming online:

## Important Update: MSNBC is Now "MS NOW"

MSNBC was officially rebranded as **MS NOW** in November 2025. The name change was due to Comcast spinning off its cable networks (including MSNBC) into a new company called **Versant**. MS NOW stands for **"My Source for News, Opinion, and the World."** The programming, hosts, and editorial stance remain exactly the same—only the name and branding changed (no more NBC peacock logo).

---

## Free Streaming Options

### Third-Party Free Streaming Sites
Several websites offer free MSNBC/MS NOW live streams without requiring a cable login or subscription:
- **Live News Chat** (livenewschat.eu) – Free 24/7 HD stream, no signup required
- **US News On** (usnewson.com) – Free MS NOW live streaming
- **Live News Time** (livenewstime.com) – Free stream available
- **NewsLive.com** (newslive.com) – Free MSNBC online streaming

**⚠️ Note:** These unofficial free streams may operate in legal gray areas and can be unreliable or contain ads.

---

## Official/Authorized Options (Most with Free Trials)

| Service | Free Trial | Monthly Cost | Notes |
|---------|-----------|--------------|-------|
| **fuboTV** | 7 days | ~$79.99-$94.99 | Includes 172+ channels |
| **Hulu + Live TV** | 3 days | ~$76.99 | Includes Hulu, Disney+, ESPN+ |
| **YouTube TV** | Varies | ~$82.99 | 85+ channels, unlimited DVR |
| **Sling TV (Blue)** | None | ~$50.99 | Budget option, 42 channels |
| **Peacock** | Free tier available | Premium for full access | NBCUniversal's streaming service |

**Pro tip:** You can combine free trials from different services to watch MSNBC/MS NOW for free for several weeks—just remember to cancel before the trial ends to avoid charges.

---

## Devices Supported
- Smartphones & tablets (iOS/Android)
- Smart TVs (Samsung, LG, Sony, VIZIO)
- Streaming devices (Roku, Amazon Fire TV, Apple TV, Chromecast)
- Computers (web browsers)
- Gaming consoles (Xbox, PlayStation on some services)

---

## Key MSNBC/MS NOW Shows Still Airing
- **Morning Joe** (6-10 AM ET weekdays)
- **The Rachel Maddow Show** (Mondays, 9 PM ET)
- **Inside with Jen Psaki** (Tue-Fri, 9 PM ET)
- **The Last Word with Lawrence O'Donnell** (10 PM ET)
- **Deadline: White House with Nicolle Wallace** (4-6 PM ET)
- **All In with Chris Hayes** (8 PM ET)
